**What were you trying to do when you wanted this?**

The concrete moment matters more than the feature name — "I wanted to know if I was training legs
enough" leads somewhere better than "add a muscle chart".

**What do you do instead today?**

**Anything it must not break?** PRODUCT.md lists what the app deliberately refuses to be; an idea
that fights it can still be right, but it helps to say so up front.
